invariants.rationale: The factory method returns a HoodieJavaTable<T> created from the inputs; null is not expected.
The result object should always be an instance of HoodieJavaTable<T>.
config is used in building the metaClient and passed to the next factory call; it should be non-null.
context is dereferenced for storage config and further passed; must not be null.
result is a new HoodieJavaTable and should not be the same instance as the config input.
